regions.summary: Resolve the nine-byte world descriptor and select RAM0633 +31*slot, where the caller bounds slot to0..3. Clear all31 bytes, copy profile groups into fields5..8 and0C..0F, and construct type, coordinates, animation, counters and behavior from descriptor/profile fields. Reject profile state3 when the requested state is FF by clearing the first two actor bytes and returning FF. Otherwise save per-slot descriptor bytes7/8 to0410/0411 and return zero. Preserve descriptor and actor bases in scratch0C/0E during pointer rebasing.
